name: io_setup
description: The io_setup() system call creates an asynchronous I/O context for concurrently processing up to nr_events operations. The ctx_idp argument must be a pointer to an aio_context_t initialized to 0, and on success, it is set to the new context handle.

parameters.name: nr_events
parameters.description: The maximum number of events that can be processed concurrently in the AIO context.

parameters.name: ctx_idp
parameters.description: Pointer to an aio_context_t that must be initialized to 0; on success, it holds the new AIO context handle.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and sets errno

errors.description: The specified nr_events exceeds the user limit, as defined in /proc/sys/fs/aio-max-nr.
An invalid pointer is passed for ctx_idp.
ctx_idp is not initialized, or the specified nr_events exceeds internal limits and must be greater than 0.
io_setup() is not implemented on this architecture.
